alternatives: Generate-and-filter teacher traces or the existing 35 verified trajectories without targeted correction.

brief.applicability: Use the review budget on 50 student failure cases and 50 teacher-generated traces from matched questions. Blind reviewers label executable validity, evidence location, support, and novel corrective action; replay each corrected trace. If later training is authorized, compare equal-size datasets on named held-out questions.
constraints: No paid model APIs, GPU, or training in this pilot.
Development results are provisional; do not represent independent human support review.
brief.expected_signal: Favor corrected failures for the next dataset only if at least 10 more of 50 reviewed cases provide replay-valid, independently support-checked useful supervision than the matched teacher set. Training threshold is explicitly unset pending a held-out evaluation protocol.
brief.hypothesis: Prioritize manually corrected failure cases from the student reader, especially unsupported answers with successful execution. Retain a smaller teacher-trace sample as a comparator.
limitations: This draft is a decision aid; it has not been executed or independently validated.

observations.text: Qwen3-8B code-execution paper reader has 35 replay-verified trajectories. On 40 development questions, v5 SFT changed recorded execution-error episodes from 22 to 1; provisional supported-answer passes on 20 answerable cases stayed at 3 for base and v5.

brief.question: With capacity to review ~100 more trajectories, prioritize teacher-generated traces or manually corrected failure cases?
unknowns: The cited agent studies use web or tool benchmarks and different teachers; manual correction quality and time per case are unmeasured. A near-miss in those studies may differ from a paper-QA support failure.
